distinctStimuli.note: A duplicate has the same relationship type, source and target as an earlier protected case (the incorrect-mapping family S10 repeats the coherent family S07 except for its ILO-CLO pair). Duplicates stay in the set as a built-in repeat check but count once in statistics.

protected.stimulusRule: A protected side text (source or target) is shared when, after whitespace/case normalisation, it equals a side text of any non-protected benchmark case, or when it has at least 3 word trigrams (words longer than 3 letters) and at least 60% of them occur in one such side text. P-core = eligible cases with both sides novel; P-shared = eligible cases with at least one shared side. Every non-protected case counts, not only the development set, because any of them may be read during development.
